AUTOMATIC CLAMPING: EQUIPMENT SHOULD INCLUDE A MOTOR-ACTIVATED CLAMP THAT CLOSES AUTOMATICALLY WHEN THE PROGRAMMED VOLUME IS REACHED. CLAMP CAN BE RELEASED MANUALLY IN CASE OF EMERGENCY.

6. LOW FLOW SAFETY: EQUIPMENT SHOULD AUTOMATICALLY CLAMP THE TUBING IF THE FLOW RATE REM AINS BELOW 20 ML/MIN FOR MORE THAN 2 MINUTES. 7. DISPLAY FEATURES: EQUIPMENT SHOULD FEATURE A BACKLIT LCD DISPLAY SHOWING REAL-TIME FLOW RATE, COLLECTED VOLUME, ELAPSED TIME, ALARMS, AND DEVICE STATUS. 8. ALARM SYSTEMS: EQUIPMENT SHOULD PROVIDE BOTH AUDIBLE AND VISIBLE ALARMS FOR LOW FLOW ( BELOW 20 ML/MIN), HIGH FLOW (ABOVE 180 ML/MIN), POWER FAILURE, AND LOW BATTERY. 9. BATTERY CAPACITY: EQUIPMENT SHOULD INCLUDE A RECHARGEABLE LITHIUM ION BATTERY PROVIDING AT LEAST 12 HOURS OF BACKUP OR THE CAPACITY FOR 90 CONTINUOUS COLLECTIONS. 10. MEMORY FUNCTION: EQUIPMENT SHOULD FEATURE AUTOMATIC STORAGE AND RECALL OF THE PREVI OUSLY SET VOLUME. 11. TRAY DESIGN: EQUIPMENT SHOULD HAVE A REMOVABLE AND AUTOCLAVABLE TRAY. 12. SAFETY COMPLIANCE: EQUIPMENT SHOULD BE DESIGNED TO MEET EN 60601-1 INTERNATIONAL SAFE TY REQUIREMENTS FOR MEDICAL ELECTRICAL EQUIPMENT. 13. OPERATIONAL INDICATORS: EQUIPMENT SHOULD DISPLAY THE TOTAL DURATION OF COLLECTION AT T HE END OF EVERY PROCEDURE. 14. PORTABILITY: EQUIPMENT SHOULD BE LIGHTWEIGHT (PREFERABLY LESS THAN 5 KG) AND INCLUDE A S UITABLE CARRYING BAG FOR MOBILE DONATION CAMPS. 15. PHYSICAL DIMENSIONS: EXTERNAL DIMENSIONS OF THE EQUIPMENT SHOULD BE LESS THAN OR EQUA L TO 200 MM × 500 MM × 190 MM (W × D × H). 16. POWER SUPPLY: THERE SHOULD BE A POWER ADAPTER ALONG WITH THE EQUIPMENT. 17. WORKING ENVIRONMENT: EQUIPMENT SHOULD BE FUNCTIONAL WITHIN A TEMPERATURE RANGE OF 1 0 °C TO 40 °C AND A RELATIVE HUMIDITY OF 30% TO 75% AND ATMOSPHERIC PRESSURE 70 HPA TO 1060 HPA 18. STORAGE CONDITIONS: EQUIPMENT SHOULD WITHSTAND STORAGE TEMPERATURES FROM -20 °C TO 40 °C AND RELATIVE HUMIDITY UP TO 90% WITHOUT CONDENSATION. 19.
